steps.step: U1.R-sector states with GSO = the 128 spinor roots of the project's E8; NS bilinears +-e_i+-e_j = the 112 integer roots
U2.carrier: the project's chiral spinor block has EVEN occupation of the 5 carrier modes (S+ = Lambda^even C^5, 16 states)
U3.family lines = family occupation 0 (Fock vacuum) or 2 (Lambda^2 C^3); the project's OMITTED line is the family Fock vacuum
U4.S48 = {carrier even, family number 2} in the R sector equals the project's retained 48 exactly
U5.z3 = exp(2 pi i (2/3) N_fam), z4 = carrier-parity phase (1/4 even, 3/4 odd); hypercharge = sum_i y_i n_i (linear in carrier occupations)
U6.(-1)^F of the Z2 sheet = -1 exactly on the R sector = the spinor roots (the mu8 deck lift g^4 of C10)
U7.E8 = closure: det D5 = det D3 = 4, det E8 = 1 -> index sqrt(16) = 4; a spinor class has order 4 in the quotient (cyclic Z4 glue); D5, D3 inside the 112 NS roots
U8.the flavor monodromy group (|G| = 24) is real: Frobenius-Schur indicator +1, i.e. real rotations SO(3) < U(3) < SO(6) of the family modes
U9.(statement) the chiral seam net's own geometric group is PSL(2,R) (dim 3), not a 3+1D group: Theorem D is NOT a corollary of U
steps.detail: a 3+1D geometry needs a net indexed by 4D regions (e.g. the 2+1 Chern bulk of the QWZ edge is only 3D)
